Main.dc.html.title: 01 · Week view · cards you can move say “Drag to change the time”; every card is as tall as the meeting

DragMove.dc.html.title: 02 · Dragging · snaps to 15 minutes, shows the new start and end; the original slot stays outlined

DragPast.dc.html.title: 03 · Over a time that has passed · past slots are shaded; dropping here puts the card back

DragDrop.dc.html.title: 04 · Drop · the card lands in the slot: a short press and one ring (about a quarter of a second), then the confirmation opens; shown here on a loop

DragConfirm.dc.html.title: 04b · Confirm · choose which meetings the move applies to, and see how many participants are busy then

DragMoved.dc.html.title: 05 · Moved · the dialog closes at once; the card shows “Saved, syncing…” until Google Calendar confirms (RoB Async) and can’t be dragged meanwhile

DragFailed.dc.html.title: 06 · Sync failed · the card is marked; the meeting view offers Try again (RoB Async states)

RespondView.dc.html.title: 07 · Participant’s meeting view · Decline and Propose new time

DeclineDialog.dc.html.title: 08 · Decline this meeting? · optional comment for the owner

Declined.dc.html.title: 09 · Declined · Accept undoes it until the meeting starts; proposing a time stays possible; the roster shows Declined

ProposeDialog.dc.html.title: 10 · Propose new time · date, start, end and an optional comment

Proposed.dc.html.title: 11 · Proposed · the participant sees their open proposal and can change or cancel it; Decline stays possible

OwnerView.dc.html.title: 12 · Owner’s meeting view · open proposal with how many participants are busy then, Reject / Move meeting; a decline with its comment

SlackDms.dc.html.title: 13 · Slack DMs · the owner moves the meeting or rejects the proposal right in Slack; the outcome to the participant

ZoomPicker.dc.html.title: 14 · Create meeting · Zoom: Auto-created or Custom link

ZoomCustom.dc.html.title: 15 · Custom link · checked in the company’s Zoom account: a recurring meeting hosted by the owner; Auto-Recording stays

ZoomError.dc.html.title: 16 · Not a meeting link · personal room links and other links are rejected as you type

ZoomCheckError.dc.html.title: 17 · Fails the Zoom check · another host, another account, one-time or instant, expired

ZoomScope.dc.html.title: 18 · Edit · a Zoom link change applies to this and following, or all meetings

ZoomMeetingView.dc.html.title: 19 · Meeting view · REC plus a Custom link tag; your company’s Zoom settings still apply

Prototype.dc.html.title: 20 · Clickable prototype · drag your meetings, open People Leadership Weekly (you’re a participant), Recruiting Pipeline (you own it), edit any of yours, or open last Thursday’s Talent Onboarding Automation, a 5-minute call, and move it to a later day

RespondViewM.dc.html.title: 07m · Phone · the meeting view opens full screen, the date box moves above Details; Decline and Propose new time fill the footer

DeclineDialogM.dc.html.title: 08m · Phone · Decline slides up from the bottom as a drawer (as the app’s action drawers); tap outside or Cancel to close

DeclinedM.dc.html.title: 09m · Phone · Declined · “You declined this meeting” sits above Accept and Propose new time; the roster shows Declined

ProposeDialogM.dc.html.title: 10m · Phone · Propose new time slides up as a drawer; the date gets its own row, start and end share the next

ProposedM.dc.html.title: 11m · Phone · Proposed · Cancel proposal moves under the text; Change proposal sits in the footer

OwnerViewM.dc.html.title: 12m · Phone · Owner · the open proposal comes first, Reject and Move meeting under its text

OwnerDeclineM.dc.html.title: 12m-b · Phone · Owner · tapping a participant’s status shows their decline comment

PhoneParticipant.dc.html.title: 21 · Phone prototype · you’re a participant in People Leadership Weekly: decline, accept, propose a time, change or cancel it

PhoneOwner.dc.html.title: 22 · Phone prototype · you own Recruiting Pipeline: move the meeting to Hannah’s proposed time or reject it

PastMoved.dc.html.title: 24 · Moved · an upcoming meeting again; the 5-minute recording stays on it, marked “recorded on Oct 8” on the same line

PastHistory.dc.html.title: 25 · History · one row for the meeting, titled “Oct 13, 2026 (moved from Oct 8)”; the recording from the original time comes last

PastSlack.dc.html.title: 26 · Slack · the card from Thursday says where the meeting went; a new card arrives before the new time

PastEditScope.dc.html.title: 23 · Save · a new date or time applies to this meeting only or to all meetings, as for the next meeting; the note says the meeting has ended (or “is in progress” while it runs) and anything recorded at the original time stays with it
